newsitem.title: USA: Total Renal files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Total Renal files for offering.

text.p: Total Renal Care Holdings Inc on Friday filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of approximately 3,000,000 shares of common stock.

In a statement the company said that the registration statement is being filed in response to a demand registration right exercised by institutional stockholders, which are not affiliates of the company.
Total Renal expects approximately 2,500,000 shares will be sold by these and other stockholders and 500,000 will be sold by the company.
The company intends to use the proceeds from the sale of shares by the company for acquisitions, de novo development and for working capital and other corporate purposes.
Pending such uses, the company will use such proceeds to reduce the amount under the revolving portion of the Company's credit facility.
The company said it will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of the shares being sold by the selling stockholders.
